data.name: Night of the oldbrand
data.detailed_description:
Night of the oldbrand is a roguelike horror game, set in a haunted old house. By day, explore its corridors, scavenge for scarce ammunition, and manage your fragile sanity to prepare for the horrors ahead. By night, engage in combat in darkness fending off the relentless assault of the cult.

Key Features:

  • Roguelike Permadeath: Every run is a high-stakes challenge. Death is permanent, resetting your progress in the race to survive until the end.

  • Dynamic Day-Night Cycle: Experience a seamless cycle where days are for exploration and recovery, while nights unleash brutal battles against mysterious and otherworldly threats.

  • Intense Combat: Confront the overhelming odds with limited arsenal. 

  • Sanity Management: Maintain your grip on reality as the house’s horrors erode your mind.

  • Relentless Horror: Face increasingly aggressive and mysterious entities that grow deadlier with each passing night, pushing your survival skills to the limit.

  • Strategic Survival: Balance exploration, ammo conservation, and sanity management to endure the terror.

Epilepsy Warning

This game contains flashing lights, patterns, or sudden visual changes that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy or other similar conditions. If you or anyone in your household has a history of seizures or epilepsy, please consult a physician before playing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: We recommend you install the game on SSD drive for better experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-13600K or AMD Ryzen 7 7700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD RX 6800-XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: We recommend you install the game on SSD drive for better experience.
